name: Frozen repository verification

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  evidence:
    name: Verify preserved evidence (no model calls)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Verify closeout snapshot and original freezes
        run: node benchmark/verify-closeout.mjs
      - name: Test analysis and historical refusal classifier
        run: node --test benchmark/analysis/cluster_report.test.mjs benchmark/gate-increment/classify.test.mjs

  rust-regression:
    name: Check frozen Rust source (no distribution)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
      - name: Test workspace
        run: cargo test --workspace --locked
      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
